2123543746444984671.en_summary: When everything starts dropping together, that is a liquidation event. We just started getting that the last 2-3 days. Hedges like $NKE $PEP $MCD etc all moving with the market, this is generally a sign of forced liquidations, closer to the “finale” than not.
2123543746444984671.zh_summary: 當一切開始一起下跌時，那就是清算事件。我們在過去2-3天剛剛開始出現這種情況。像$NKE $PEP $MCD等對沖標的都隨著市場移動，這通常是強制清算的跡象，更接近「終章」而不是不是。
